narrationScript: Welcome to Cohortia's journey into the foundational world of C programming! This chapter, 'Your First C Program: Hello, World!', is your official entry point into writing code. By the end of this lesson, you'll be able to understand the basic structure of a C program, write, compile, and execute your very own 'Hello, World!' application. We'll also demystify the purpose of `#include <stdio.h>`, explore the crucial `main` function, and master the `printf` function for displaying text. Finally, you'll learn to recognize and troubleshoot common syntax errors, making you a confident beginner C programmer.
